blogs.title: Why Orthogonal Finetuning Matters: Preserving Knowledge Without Relearning
blogs.description: This post explains the core challenge of adapting massive AI models like GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to new tasks. It introduces 'Orthogonal Finetuning' (OFT) as a solution that ensures the fine-tuned model retains the original pre-trained knowledge by preserving the geometric relationships between neurons. We'll discuss how this approach differs from standard fine-tuning and why maintaining those precise angles is crucial for preventing catastrophic forgetting.

blogs.title: From Block-Diagonal to Butterflies: The Quest for Smarter Parameter Efficiency
blogs.description: While Orthogonal Finetuning works well, it traditionally relies on a 'block-diagonal' structure that limits expressiveness and wastes computational resources. This article dives into the authors' breakthrough: using 'butterfly structures,' inspired by the famous Fast Fourier Transform algorithm, to create a denser representation of orthogonal transformations. You'll learn how this new method allows models to capture complex interactions with far fewer trainable parameters.
